# Scripts

<!-- Generated by build_readme.py from each script's header. Do not edit by hand. -->

Command-line tools, one folder per topic. Python scripts run with [uv](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/) and declare their own dependencies inline, so there is nothing to install first. Run everything from the repository root.

## books

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`books/goodreads_fetch.py`](books/goodreads_fetch.py) | Goodreads list / shelf fetcher |

`books/goodreads_fetch.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py                       # urls.txt -> goodreads-out/
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py --format csv          # CSV only
uv run scripts/books/goodreads_fetch.py --urls my.txt --out books --delay 5
```

## cosmos

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`cosmos/cosmos-collections.js`](cosmos/cosmos-collections.js) | Cosmos.so collections scraper — paste into the DevTools Console. |
| [`cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs`](cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs) | Checklist runner for the Cosmos scrapers. |
| [`cosmos/cosmos-scraper.js`](cosmos/cosmos-scraper.js) | Cosmos.so collection scraper — paste into the DevTools Console on a collection page (e.g. https://www.cosmos.so/&lt;user&gt;/&lt;collection&gt;). |
| [`cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py`](cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py) | Cosmos.so scraper |

`cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs`

```bash
node scripts/cosmos/cosmos-run.mjs [checklist.md] [--force] [--only <substring>]
```

`cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py                 # reads cosmos-urls.txt
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py my-links.txt    # or any file
uv run scripts/cosmos/cosmos_scrape.py --force         # re-scrape everything
```

## discord

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`discord/discord_export.py`](discord/discord_export.py) | export channel history from a Discord server you own/administer |

`discord/discord_export.py`

```bash

```

## wikimedia

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`wikimedia/wiki_info.py`](wikimedia/wiki_info.py) | Wikipedia URLs -&gt; title, url, Wikidata Q-number, AutoDesc description. |
| [`wikimedia/wp_tags.py`](wikimedia/wp_tags.py) | List every tag on a WordPress site (via its REST API), no posts fetched. |

`wikimedia/wiki_info.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py                       # reads ./urls.txt, writes ./wiki-info.csv
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --input links.csv --column link --output out.csv
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --mode short          # short AutoDesc descriptions
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --md notes.md         # also append a Markdown file
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --no-desc             # title/url/Q only, no AutoDesc calls
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wiki_info.py --force               # redo URLs already in the output
```

`wikimedia/wp_tags.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wp_tags.py https://longreads.com
uv run scripts/wikimedia/wp_tags.py https://longreads.com --max-pages 2   # quick test
```

## (top level)

| Script | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`build_readme.py`](build_readme.py) | regenerate scripts/README.md from the scripts in this folder. |

`build_readme.py`

```bash
uv run scripts/build_readme.py          # rewrite scripts/README.md
uv run scripts/build_readme.py --check  # exit 1 if README is out of date
```
